title: Connect nonsplit tensor recognition to special-linear transport
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR5664 recovers coefficient-field tables in arbitrary bases; PR5663's character witnesses require common explicit residue presentations. This connects those interfaces, retaining the actual field-basis and component-order determinants, and constructs determinant-one transporters between arbitrary accepted tensors. **No new kappa is claimed.**

For two degree-d fields C,D over K, split `C tensor_K D` into primitive factors. On any factor, both coefficient embeddings are isomorphisms, so a linear solve gives C -> D. The bridge checks the unit, invertibility and every basis product without enumerating all q^d elements. Extending these maps across monomials gives a model map S; normalization changes `(U,V,W)` to `(US,VS,WS)` and divides the determinant ratio by `det(S)`. The proof shows that alternative field isomorphisms and equal-type component pairings yield the same label relative to the fixed reference model.

Equal full types and equal labels are necessary and sufficient for an SL isotopy. The executable constructs and checks `t2(Px,Qy)=R t1(x,y)` with all three determinants one, plus the covariant maps `P^(-T),Q^(-T),R`. Reference residue presentations remain explicit parameters. Only the field-table bridge is polynomial in degree for fixed K; the retained full arithmetic tables and norm-preimage searches keep their enumerative costs.

[Proof](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/578c7ac422d4e00da5c7d1b0f69d71810ea28a6f/research/nonsplit-sl-transport/PROOF.md) · [Contract](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/578c7ac422d4e00da5c7d1b0f69d71810ea28a6f/research/nonsplit-sl-transport/README.md) · [Exact report](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/578c7ac422d4e00da5c7d1b0f69d71810ea28a6f/research/nonsplit-sl-transport/RESULT.json) · [Validation](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/578c7ac422d4e00da5c7d1b0f69d71810ea28a6f/research/nonsplit-sl-transport/VALIDATION.md).

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority 7, refreshed before selection and submission. This takes PR5664's explicit released integration question; [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5655#discussioncomment-19188216). Exact immediate dependencies: Ali Romman's PR5664 `8f7773e700d468396cbf893dfb18bf3ae6c20f66` and apoursh's PR5663 `d72b2e42a4cf53ae85f5276da65c5cc84e17b253`. Their consumed sources are retained unchanged and pinned to this branch's first commit, with original paths/blobs/digests in ORIGINS.json.

TASK.json declares the changed formal-interface card and compares the separate regular-pencil gap before choosing this named consumer. Fresh live handoffs, the canonical thread and bounded all-state PR searches found no competing bridge. The repository overlap helper had no usable remote cache and searched only 33 of 7,676 tracked notes; no complete historical or unpublished-work coverage is claimed. PR5525/5540 cover earlier recognition, not this cross-presentation character composition. Only this new opt-in package changes.

## Validation

Final head `578c7ac422d4e00da5c7d1b0f69d71810ea28a6f`, CPython 3.12.14/macOS arm64, standard library:

- All 44 unit-first bases in four small field domains and all 112 primitive-component field identifications.
- Six actual recognition/transport fixtures over F2/F3/F4/F9, including nonsplit nilpotents and repeated/mixed types; independent coefficient checks reject omitted inverse-transposes in every fixture.
- All 512 quadratic-residue determinant triples over F9: 128 verified SL transporters and 384 rejected cosets, with four labels.
- All 54 specified component-order/field-choice combinations; eight alternative-reference pairs; explicit wrong raw-label and odd-permutation controls.
- Twenty-three malformed-input rejections, including a false absolute-Frobenius certificate over F4, and two equal-dimension/different-type rejections.

Registered warning-strict isolated normal/optimized replay passes with identical reports. Committed-byte and source-history checks pass for all 19 files. The official export passes integrity checking; both normal and optimized direct commands reproduce the complete committed RESULT from a read-only Git-free export with `PATH=/nonexistent` (about 1.49/1.58 seconds). All 20 exported files, including the export manifest, retain their bytes and modes. Actual one-byte mutations of each of ten live inputs reject before adapter import. Archive SHA256: `30d3ade8e751a4190b7ff6922a32def976bea750708d4a2c9ee04c4bf91fa1f1`.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonsplit-sl-transport
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/nonsplit-sl-transport --check-source-history
```

These are bounded finite checks plus a written proof, not independent human/proof-kernel acceptance. The predecessor's complete tensor census, selected cold replay, native pricing, Lean and Docker were not rerun. The known upstream planning-link defect is repaired separately by PR5659; hosted CI for this PR is unconfirmed.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman PR5664/5661/5637/5459 for recognition, coefficient-field recovery and retained arithmetic; apoursh PR5663/5656/5502 for character and height work; Nick Petalas PR5252 for the etale/determinant interface; David Ganz and the retained atlas lineage. Tensor-product decomposition and finite-field structure are classical. New integration by apoursh with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate proof, implementation and independent finite-check agents. Apache-2.0; no global literature-priority claim.

## Open next questions

The algebraic interface is now connected. A multiplication-bound contribution still needs a named native producer/consumer and a complete bill for coefficients, movement, ownership, restoration, storage and precision. Efficient large-residue arithmetic is a separate task only when such a consumer specifies its required degrees and operations; the bridge does not remove the retained enumerative witness costs. README and TASK.json record these boundaries.
